lines.en: Short as I am, I float along quickly.

lines.zh: 副手里的法杖比我还高
lines.en: The staff in my off hand is taller than me.

lines.zh: 我跟在前辈后面，不敢超前
lines.en: I follow behind my elder, never ahead.

lines.zh: 我穿行时留下一串紫点
lines.en: A string of purple dots trails me.
I wipe the staff head as I go.
I never land; my feet stay lifted.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，浮得低低的
lines.en: I skirt the stone, floating low.

lines.zh: 走到阴影边上，我停一下
lines.en: At the shadow's edge I pause.
I look back to see whether the others follow.

lines.zh: 我的袍子太长，拖在身后
lines.en: My robe is too long; it drags behind.
Torches flicker as I near.
I drift that way, quickly.

lines.zh: 我举着法杖，杖头有点热
lines.en: I hold the staff up; its head is warm.
I am waiting for an order.

lines.zh: 我的个子到不了你的胸口
lines.en: I do not reach your chest.
The gem on the staff slowly brightens.
I say nothing; I only watch.
I bring the staff in front of me.
With companions near, I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 火球在杖头聚起来又散
lines.en: The fireball gathers and disperses.
I count how much fire is left.
This shadow is enough cover.

lines.zh: 我在等你走近，才换近战
lines.en: I wait for you to come close before switching.
My hands are small; the staff is heavy.
I raise the staff at you.

lines.zh: 我仰头才看得见你的脸
lines.en: I have to look up to see your face
I step behind my companion.
My staff head flares once.
If you stay still, I will not loose it.
The fireball is small, but very hot.
I am checking how far you are.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的杖就抬起来
lines.en: One more step and my staff comes up
I hold the staff up, hand trembling.
My people are all this small.
Just take one step back.

lines.zh: 我盯着你护甲之间的缝
lines.en: I stare at the gap between your armor plates
I raise the staff tip an inch.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我记住了
lines.en: I noted the moment you blinked.
I am knocked drifting.
The staff head dims; I relight it.

lines.zh: 我发出一声短促的尖响
lines.en: I let out a short, sharp squeak
I shrink back into my robe.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的袍子撕开
lines.en: That tore my robe.

lines.zh: 我的个子小，伤得却实在
lines.en: Small as I am, the wound is real.
I cannot lift the staff hand.
The purple light is half gone.
I watch you; the fire is still lit.
I will call my elder.
Iron? I can trade you something better.
Gold will do too.
I recognize what you are offering.
That much iron is not enough.
Have you counted it out?
I hold out the staff, then pull it back.
Emeralds can buy a bigger one.
This much could buy a bigger staff
I have made this trade many times.
Wait; I will go fetch it.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我被推得倒退
lines.en: You slam in and I slide back.
I am too light to hold my ground.
The staff nearly slips from my hand.
I lift to get clear.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，紫色的火花溅开
lines.en: We collide and purple sparks spray.
I back to the wall and raise the staff again.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我的杖头暗了
lines.en: That dimmed my staff head.
The hit spins me off to one side

lines.zh: 地上的草被点着一小片
lines.en: A small patch of grass catches fire.
I circle to the other side.
I am too small for that yet.

lines.zh: 同族之间，是前辈带着后辈
lines.en: Among us, elders lead the young.
We float together without crowding.
Your staff is large; mine is small.

lines.zh: 我们一起放火，会很难看
lines.en: If we both loose fire, it will be ugly.

lines.zh: 我不怕黑，只怕没人带路
lines.en: I do not fear the dark, only being without a guide.
We keep this shadow together.

lines.zh: 同类之间有默契，不用说
lines.en: We understand each other without words.
I will follow your firelight.
My people never scatter.
I cup it in both hands.
Iron is heavy; I cannot lift it.
I hide it inside my robe.
This much is enough for a trade.
I check the quality first.
I set it beside the staff.

lines.zh: 绿宝石的话，我换大的给你
lines.en: For an emerald, I will give you the bigger one.
It is rather hot to hold.
I count them one by one.
I do not keep these for myself.

lines.zh: 你踏进了杖能够到的地方
lines.en: You stepped within my staff's reach
I will try one shot first.
Fire gathers at the staff head.
This distance suits a fireball.
Hold still; the fireball is ready
I lift the staff tip a little higher
Do not laugh; I am serious.
That flame did not scare you?
I will back up a little and fire.
The wall is behind you.

lines.zh: 我族的人从来不怕大个子
lines.en: My people never fear big ones.
The staff head points at your chest

lines.zh: 我飘在你侧面，杖一直举着
lines.en: I hover at your flank, staff up.
You come near, I give ground.
The fireball takes a moment to travel.
I am tracking where you are.
My staff head stays on you.
You circle the wall; so do I.

lines.zh: 等你近到足够，我换近战
lines.en: Get close enough and I switch to melee.
No hurry; the fire stays lit.
My hands are already hot.
One more.
Is your clothing burning?
I retreat into shadow, then fire again.

lines.zh: 最后靠近我，你就知道了
lines.en: Come near at the end, and you will see.

lines.zh: 太近了，我换手里的家伙
lines.en: Too close; I switch to my other hand.
I swing the staff into your leg.
The fireball bursts at close range.

lines.zh: 这一下连我自己都被燎到
lines.en: That one singed even me.
I am too short, so I hit low.
You step back, and I fire again.

lines.zh: 杖砸下去，木头磕得很响
lines.en: The staff lands with a wooden clack.
I do not chase; I wait for you to come near.
I back off and gather fire again.
My hand is burnt red.
I put my whole weight behind the staff
You are still moving; I am surprised.
My elder brought me here.

lines.zh: 杖头先亮，然后我才现身
lines.en: The staff head lights first, then I appear.
This shadow is new.

lines.zh: 我浮在半空，比前辈矮一头
lines.en: I float, a head shorter than my elder.
I steady myself on the staff.

lines.zh: 周围的风里有火的味道
lines.en: The wind here smells of fire.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了一圈，记下了
lines.en: I scan once and memorize it.
This is my first time out alone.
The staff is heavy in my grip.

lines.zh: 我不踩地，落地会留下印
lines.en: I do not touch down; it would leave marks.

lines.zh: 远处有个身影，我警觉了
lines.en: A figure far off; I am on guard.
The fire wakes in my hands.

lines.zh: 我落在这里，先数身边的阴影
lines.en: I land here and count the shadows first.

lines.zh: 火烧到我，我分不清哪边是自己的火
lines.en: Fire hits me and I cannot tell mine from yours.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，撞在地上弹了一下
lines.en: I fall and bounce off the ground.
Water puts out the fire on my staff.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹得翻了跟头
lines.en: The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的袖子上
lines.en: An arrow pins my sleeve.

lines.zh: 那股力把我从半空摁下去
lines.en: That force presses me down out of the air.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，火就是我的粮
lines.en: I do not eat; fire is my food.
The lightning is far brighter than my fire.
There is nothing beneath me.
